provenance.paper_title: DynScene: Scalable Generation of Dynamic Robotic Manipulation Scenes for Embodied AI
provenance.notes: Original DynScene source layout/colors with native pipeline panels, U-Nets, state grids, arrows, quaternion diagram and separately editable room-layout gradient contours. Corrupt PDF character encoding repaired by accurate source-pixel transcription into live ordinary labels. Six discrete robot/scene visuals are rendered with original source text suppressed, so typed labels leave no hidden originals. Twelve mathematical expressions are isolated raster inserts. Source decorative drop shadows on native arrows omitted. Freeform paths are not attached connectors.
